name: Cindrella Hotels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Cindrella Hotels Ltd runs a 4-star facility hotel in Siliguri[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CHL is in the business of hospitality, travel and tourism sector and operating a hotel by the name of The Cindrella Hotel at Siliguri. Its business activities encompass Darjeeling district, state of Sikkim and Bhutan. A portion of its revenues comes from sale of food and beverages at its restaurant and operation of health club, park rental for marriages and other occasions. It is also engaged in selling tour packages to domestic and international travelers.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 81.9%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 3.96% over last 3 years.
